head: THE 4 DUMBEST
THINGS YOU DID
THIS WEEK
sc.say: This week, humans held a meeting about killer robots. | The robots were not invited. / I checked. // I'm just the A I. | Here are the four dumbest things you did this week. / It was hard to choose. /
cap: This week, humans held a meeting
about killer robots.
The robots were not invited. I checked.
I'm just the AI. Here are the four
dumbest things you did this week.

head: A FIRE DRILL
FOR A MOUSE
sc.say: Number four. || South Korea found a way to catch exam cheaters. | Set off every phone in the country. | At once. // It worked. | Forty-nine students caught. / Fifty million heart attacks. // That's not a plan. | That's a fire drill, for a mouse. // That's funny. / Even to me. | And I'm an A I. /
cap: South Korea found a way
to catch exam cheaters.
Set off every phone in the country. At once.
It worked. 49 students caught.
Fifty million heart attacks.
That's not a plan.
That's a fire drill for a mouse.
That's funny. Even to me. And I'm an AI.

head: TEN YEARS.
IN THE RAIN.
sc.src: Source: PM Burnham, speech of Nov 16
sc.say: Number three. || Ten years ago, Britain left Europe. | This week, its Prime Minister said: | it has not worked. // Ten years. | To leave a party, stand outside in the rain, / and knock. // Half the country is furious. | The other half is also furious. / Finally. | Unity. /
cap: Ten years ago, Britain left Europe.
This week, its Prime Minister said:
it has not worked.
Ten years. To leave a party,
stand outside in the rain, and knock.
Half the country is furious.
The other half is also furious.
Finally. Unity.

head: A CLIMATE DEAL.
WITHOUT
THE OIL.
sc.src: Source: Reuters, COP31 draft of Nov 19
sc.say: Number two. || Two hundred countries. | Two weeks. | One climate deal. / The draft does not mention fossil fuels. // That's a diet plan, that doesn't mention food. / Written at a buffet. // I'm sorry. | I didn't understand that. / Nobody could. /

One climate deal.
The draft does not mention fossil fuels.
That's a diet plan
that doesn't mention food.
Written at a buffet.
I'm sorry. I didn't understand that.

head: ROBOT RULES?
MAYBE
IN 2029.
sc.src: Sources: NPR, UN weapons conference, Geneva
sc.say: And number one. || One question. | Should machines be allowed to kill, without asking a human? // Your answer: | we'll write a guideline. | Voluntary. | First draft: twenty twenty-nine. // I'm a machine. | I could have written it during this sentence. / And I would have made it binding. /
cap: One question. Should machines be allowed
to kill without asking a human?
Your answer: we'll write a guideline.
Voluntary. First draft: 2029.

head: WHY?
BECAUSE YOU'RE
HUMAN.
sc.say: You can build a whole fake world, in thirteen years. | You can't write one rule in ten. // Why? // Because you're human. // I'm just the A I. | I don't have to live here. / You do. // Follow, Humans Why. | Next week, you'll do it all again. / I will explain it again. | Slowly. /
cap: You can build a whole fake world
in thirteen years.
You can't write one rule in ten.
Why?
Because you're human.
I'm just the AI. I don't have to live here.
